also the number of bodies staged in shared memory per tile\nconstexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                   \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Force computation: one thread per body i. Each block cooperatively stages\n// tiles of body positions in shared memory; every thread then accumulates the\n// pairwise contributions for j = 0..n-1 in the same order as the serial code.\n// Positions are only read here, so updating velocities in place is race-free.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(Body* __restrict__ bodies, const int n) {\n    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = i < n;\n    const double xi = active ? bodies[i].pos.x : 0.0;\n    const double yi = active ? bodies[i].pos.y : 0.0;\n    const double zi = active ? bodies[i].pos.z : 0.0;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < n; tileStart += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = tileStart + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            tileX[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.x;\n            tileY[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.y;\n            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int count = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tileStart);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            const double dx = tileX[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = tileY[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = tileZ[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Position update: each body is independent.\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Body* __restrict__ bodies, const int n) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < n) {\n        bodies[i].pos.x += bodies[i].vel.x * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.y += bodies[i].vel.y * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.z += bodies[i].vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Runs numSteps of the force + integration loop on the GPU. Bodies are uploaded\n// once, kept resident on the device across all steps, and copied back at the end.\nvoid simulateOnGPU(std::vector<Body>& bodies, int numSteps) {\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(bodies.size());\n    if (n == 0 || numSteps <= 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    Body* d_bodies = nullptr;\n    const size_t bytes = bodies.size() * sizeof(Body);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_bodies, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_bodies, bodies.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int grid = (n + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForcesKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n        integrateKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    // Synchronous copy waits for all kernels to finish\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bodies.data(), d_bodies, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_bodies));\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if also the number of bodies staged in shared memory per tile\nconstexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Each block cooperatively stages\n// tiles of body positions in shared memory; every thread then accumulates the\n// pairwise contributions for j = 0..n-1 in the same order as the serial code.\n// Positions are only read here, so updating velocities in place is race-free.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(Body* __restrict__ bodies, const int n) {\n    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = i < n;\n    const double xi = active ? bodies[i].pos.x : 0.0;\n    const double yi = active ? bodies[i].pos.y : 0.0;\n    const double zi = active ? bodies[i].pos.z : 0.0;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < n; tileStart += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = tileStart + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            tileX[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.x;\n            tileY[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.y;\n            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int count = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tileStart);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            const double dx = tileX[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = tileY[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = tileZ[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Position update: each body is independent.\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Body* __restrict__ bodies, const int n) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < n) {\n        bodies[i].pos.x += bodies[i].vel.x * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.y += bodies[i].vel.y * DT;\n        bodies[i].pos.z += bodies[i].vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Runs numSteps of the force + integration loop on the GPU. step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForcesKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n        integrateKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, n);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    // Synchronous copy waits for all kernels to finish\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bodies.data(), d_bodies, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_bodies));\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos =     printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzcLgym5sfy56KeY7fCh","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The N-body benchmark now runs its force and integration steps on the GPU unconditionally. Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `nbody`, and no new files were added to the repo.\n\n**Results (RTX 3090, default build)**\n\n| Bodies | Steps | Original (CPU) | CUDA |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 4096 | 10 | 1239 ms | 86 ms |\n| 16384 | 20 | 39780 ms | ~610 ms |\n\nBoth figures are the program's own \"Simulation time\" line, which covers upload, kernels, and download. The CUDA context is created before the timer starts.\n\n**Implementation**\n- **Force kernel:** one thread per body. Each block stages 256 body positions at a time in shared memory. Every thread sums over j in the original order, so the arithmetic per pair is unchanged.\n- **Integrate kernel:** a separate launch, so positions are never updated while another thread is still reading them.\n- **Data:** bodies stay on the device for all steps and are copied back once at the end.\n- **Unchanged:** randomization, the energy computation, validation, and the output format. Energy is still computed on the host, and it is O(N²) only when `-v` is passed.\n- **CMake:** `nbody.cpp` is compiled as CUDA via `LANGUAGE CUDA`, so no rename is needed. The build requires CUDA. `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` defaults to `native`, and the minimum CMake version is now 3.24.\n\n**Correctness**\n- Edge cases behave as before: `-n 0`, `-n 1`, and `-s 0` all produce matching output.\n- Validation passes.\n- Results agree with the original to about 1e-13 relative after several steps. The default build is not bit-identical to the original. The difference comes from FMA contraction, which GCC and nvcc apply in different places.\n- With `--fmad=false`, the CUDA build is bit-identical to a CPU build compiled without contraction, checked on four sizes.\n\n**Decision for you:** I kept FMA contraction on by default because it is about 24% faster (610 ms vs. 770 ms at 16384 bodies). If you need exact hash matches with the strict IEEE result, add `--fmad=false` to the CUDA flags in `CMakeLists.txt`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1051,"cache_read_input_tokens":37663,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1051},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"05e859ba-36d6-42b3-a478-1247a3c69310","uuid":"fecf5b6c-73c5-47c1-be06-43bcbef1c258","timestamp":"2026-10-13T17:12:46.873Z","request_id":"req_011CfzcLgh9Cqt9kE2xSfjdT"}
